issue.title: Switch the gtd_daily #pre #sync chore to bob tick -a after the bob-tick soak week

task_type_fields.proposal:
After a one-week soak of the Mac's new `*/5 bob-tick` cron job (cut over 2026-11-18 by epic bob-cli-nb), change the recurring morning chore in the Bob vault note `gtd_daily.md` from `#task #gtd #pre #sync Run `gcal sync -n 2` + `gkeep pull` + `gmail sync`` to run `bob tick -a` instead. `bob tick -a` runs every non-off step now (gcal with yesterday on the day's first run, gmail, the manual gkeep step, refs, projects, tasks) in the fixed order and reports one receipt.

Before editing, confirm the soak was clean: `cronctl logs bob-tick --machine mac` shows gcal runs at least 60 minutes apart, readiness waits instead of mail overnight, and `ssh mac 'bob tick -s'` shows every step succeeding. Edit only the open (unchecked) recurring instance; read `sase/memory/obsidian.md` (via /sase_memory_read) first for vault conventions.

Proposed by bob-cli-nb.5 note #1 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP), recorded by the bob-cli-nb land agent.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The bob-cli-nb plan deliberately deferred this chore change until the new tick schedule had soaked for a week on the Mac; changing it in the epic would have retired the manual fallback before the cron path was proven.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-nb.5 proposed this follow-up: the morning catch-up should become one bob tick -a once the Mac's bob-tick cron job has soaked for a week.
